flow: Treated With ART->AIDS People living with AIDS
param: C Constant recruitment into susceptible population (total recruitment, allocated across susceptible strata via h and c)
h Proportion of men in recruitment; used to split recruitment between men and women
c Proportion of heterosexual men among men in recruitment; used to split recruitment between homosexual men and heterosexual men
p Proportion of initially treated individuals (initial condition parameter)
λ Natural mortality rate (applies to all compartments)
δ AIDS-induced mortality rate (applies to AIDS compartment)
d AIDS development rate in treated individuals due to ART resistance or treatment failure (T → A)
a Departure rate from all compartments of infected individuals (progression from untreated infected to treated: I_* → T); identified as most sensitive parameter
b_s Probability of sexual transmission for heterosexual contact (men-women)
b_h Probability of sexual transmission for exclusive homosexual contact among homosexual men
b_hw Probability of sexual transmission for contact between homosexual men and women
b_hm Probability of sexual transmission for contact between homosexual men and heterosexual men (bisexual contact)
c_s Rate of number of sexual partners for heterosexual contact
c_h Rate of number of sexual partners for exclusive homosexual contact among homosexual men
c_hw Rate of number of sexual partners for contact between homosexual men and women
c_hm Rate of number of sexual partners for contact between homosexual men and heterosexual men
C_hom_rec Recruitment into susceptible homosexual men: C h (1-c)
C_w_rec Recruitment into susceptible women: C (1-h)
C_hetm_rec Recruitment into susceptible heterosexual men: C h c
